_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sos_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sos_sync_queue" ("queue_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sos_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ble_outbox" ("message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sos_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination_id" TEXT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_retry_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "acknowledged_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("message_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ble_inbox" ("message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sos_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender_device_id" TEXT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "processing_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "persisted_at" INTEGER NULL, "acknowledgement_status" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("message_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_messages" ("message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sos_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipient_id" TEXT NULL, "message_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "text_content" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "delivery_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attachment_path" TEXT NULL, "attachment_mime_type" TEXT NULL, "attachment_name" TEXT NULL, "remote_message_id" TEXT NULL, "transport_metadata" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("message_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ble_relay_messages" ("origin_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "incident_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_public_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "immutable_payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "wire_envelope" TEXT NOT NULL, "immutable_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_signature" TEXT NOT NULL, "authorization_scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "emergency_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "retention_deadline" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max_hops" INTEGER NOT NULL, "incoming_hop_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "incoming_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "incoming_peer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_hop_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "processing_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "storage_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "persisted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "final_receipt_state" TEXT NULL, "final_recipient_key_id" TEXT NULL, "final_authorization_id" TEXT NULL, "final_receipt_correlation_id" TEXT NULL, "final_route_peer_device_id" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("origin_message_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ble_relay_attempts" ("origin_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ble_relay_messages (origin_message_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "next_hop_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "correlation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_hop_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "outgoing_hop_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "outgoing_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_retry_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "accepted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("origin_message_id", "next_hop_key_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ble_relay_receipts" ("semantic_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ble_relay_messages (origin_message_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "incident_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "immutable_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "signer_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "signer_public_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "correlation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_id" TEXT NULL, "final_authorization_id" TEXT NULL, "source_peer_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_hop_key_id" TEXT NULL, "previous_hop_device_id" TEXT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "signature" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("semantic_key"), UNIQUE ("receipt_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rescue_inbox" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "incident_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "immutable_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "emergency_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "emergency_message" TEXT NOT NULL, "include_location" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("include_location" IN (0, 1)), "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "incoming_hop_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "incoming_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "acceptance_id" TEXT NULL, "accepted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "origin_message_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rescue_response_outbox" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "incident_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "responder_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_retry_at" INTEGER NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "final_ack_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "message_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rescue_response_inbox" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "incident_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "responder_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "immutable_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "processed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "message_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rescue_response_jobs" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "response_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_hop_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_hop_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_binding" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_retry_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "response_message_id", "next_hop_key_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rescue_response_replay" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "immutable_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "message_id"));
